exposure: Maturity-onset diabetes of the young (MODY) subtypes (MODY2, MODY3)
cohort: The study included patients with MODY3 (n=17), MODY2 (n=33), Type 1 Diabetes (T1DM) (n=34), and healthy individuals (n=30).
finding: The study identified four significantly fluctuating metabolites, including glycerophosphocholine, which served as a promising diagnostic biomarker for distinguishing MODYs from healthy controls and MODY3 from T1DM, demonstrating high AUC values.
